whyOwnerChoiceMatters: the Work Owner does not perform the actual process spawn, so it must not mint port invocation identity
the Deployment Port must not mint AttemptId or HostJobId, because those belong to different owners
correlation happens only in the host-private boundary that legitimately holds prepared.attemptId and its own jobId

invariants: entry.invocationId === entry.observation.invocationId for every correlated event
all observation.invocationId values from one port run are identical
distinct port runs carry different invocationId values
law: the Deployment Port is the sole InvocationId producer; the Work Delegation correlation wrapper adopts the identity the port emitted rather than minting a second one
